A foreign key referencing the plant system identifier, which establishes a relationship between the equipment and the plant or facility where it is installed or operated. The plant_sys_id serves as the primary key in the Plant table. In the hierarchy of equipment -> train -> block -> plant, this plant_sys_id_fk can be used as a joining field between the Plant table and Equipment table, the Train table, and the Block table.

A foreign key referencing the block system identifier, which links the equipment to a specific block or section within the plant or facility.  The block_sys_id serves as the primary key in the Block table. In the hierarchy of equipment -> train -> block -> plant, this block_sys_id_fk can be used as a joining field between the Block table and the Equipment table as well as the Train table.

A foreign key referencing the train system identifier, which associates the equipment with a particular train or production line. The train_sys_id serves as the primary key in the Train table. In the hierarchy of equipment -> train -> block -> plant, this train_sys_id_fk can be used as a joining field between the Equipment table and the Train table only.
